svg.text: ZIKORA MEDICAL CENTRE – PATIENT & OPERATIONAL PROCESS FLOW
OPD records: Total Bill / Collected / Balance

g.text: • Monitors ALL transactions: Consultation, Lab, Pharmacy, Emergency Cash, Discharge Billing
• Outstanding Balances: patient name, what is owed, total billed vs. paid, balance
• Tracks revenue by department, patient type, doctor, lab tech and pharmacist
• Reviews procurement requests from Pharmacy; reconciles with expenses
• Generates holistic Excel reports (daily / weekly / monthly)
• Monthly audit with external auditors – income, expenses, balance
• Records PV (Payment Vitae) – daily expenses approved by Doctor
• Discounts Register: tracks all approved discounts & total revenue waived
• Employee management: Doctors, Nurses, Pharmacists, Security, Day/Night Workers
• Tracks shifts, employee documents (certifications, licences, contracts)
• Absence tracking: Sick Leave, Personal, Vacation, Unauthorized
• Recruitment: job requisitions, candidates, application tracking
• Receives procurement requests from Pharmacy; approves fund release
• Manages medication & office supply procurement across all departments
• NEW: Receives discount requests from Cashier; approves or rejects with reason
• Approved discounts instantly reflected in patient's bill at the Cashier

svg.text: • Free treatment: Hospital staff, dependents, MD's relatives – recorded by Cashier
• Partial discounts on existing bills require HR approval via the Discount workflow
• All discounts tracked in Account Officer's Discounts Register for audit compliance
• % or fixed amount options; live bill preview shown before submission
• Doctor tests & diagnoses; bill written on card
• Patient pays to Cashier; returns to doctor with proof of payment
• Eye Tests: Visual Acuity ₦1k, Auto Refraction ₦5k, Tonometry ₦5k,
• Procedures: Eye Irrigation ₦5k, Foreign Body Removal ₦10k, Dilation ₦2k
• Not formally admitted; held for observation
(e.g. BP check after medication / IV fluids)
• Observations recorded on clinical card only
• OPD records both: Total Bill Amount + Cash Collected at OPD
• If collected < total bill → balance auto-recorded as partial payment
• OPD alert banner shows 3-column summary: Total Bill | Collected | Balance
• Cashier sees same breakdown; confirms receipt & collects any remaining balance
• Unpaid balance flows to Outstanding Balances tab under patient's name
• Doctor clicks "Discharge Patient" → system computes full discharge bill
• Includes: all admission charges + any previously unpaid balances
• Bill automatically appears in Cashier's "Discharge Bills" tab
• Patient officially DISCHARGED only after Cashier confirms full settlement
Zikora Medical Centre – Hospital Management System © 2026 | Developed by Zikobyte
All patient transactions flow through departments and are monitored by the Account Officer | HR oversees employees, procurement and discount approvals
